company_info.company_description: " In 2009, we were the company that installed the first innovative SolarEdge system in Australia. In 2018, we opened a solar power & battery storage showroom in Allambie Heights where, by appointment, you can view Sydney's largest range of solar storage batteries.Solar Batteries & Solar Pool HeatingWe offer you the latest world class solar technology from established brands that you can trust. We specialise in quality, optimised smart solar power systems and batteries. Unlike many other solar companies, we are also specialists in solar pool heating systems. So, if you are not only running an air conditioner but a swimming pool as well, we are the ones to call. We have innovative ways to use your solar power system to run a pool heat pump as well as other options.Maximum Power & Money Plus Great WarrantiesOur objective is get you the best value for money possible. Your system will be designed to get you the maximum use and financial benefit from the energy you can generate. Our top of the range solar systems gives you the flexibility to have panels on East, West and North roof aspects, to manage shade from trees and for each panel to produce its maximum possible power at all times. Optimised systems can increase your power output by up to 25%.Choose from high performance solar panels combined with a SolarEdge all in one optimized system, or a Fronius string inverter and your choice of additional optimising technology. We select products with industry standard or above warrranties. Solarpro warranties its installation labour for 12 years.No Building Too Large Or Small (Including Units)From small homes and businesses to large scale commercial installations, strata units and local government, if you want to get the best possible from solar please contact us. Whatever your choice, Solarpro will guide you through every step; from our free assessment and professional installation to our comprehensive after- sales service. We want you to enjoy and benefit from your system. We try to do as much as we can for you from start to finish in the process and we are local for any concerns or issues that may arise later."
company_info.specializations: quality, optimised smart solar power systems and batteries

reviews.review_description: Right from the get go the professional guidance from evaluating our needs, from quoting the system without pressure or bias and the most careful, tidy installation one could wish for.

Sales guy was very informative. Installers were excellent.  Admin/project management was a bit disorganised..However we are very pleased with the result. Extra solar on the roof and a battery which significantly reduces our energy costs

Decided on SolarPro because their reviews were all very good regarding quality of workmanship, advice, quality of components used, timeliness etc. They were local and committed to our area with prices in the expected Ted ballpark. They lived up to those standards and I am happy to reccommend them.

The Sales Quoting process was nice and easy, Ben made it easy to understand all questions answered.The installation process was very good guys were polite tidy cleaned up after them selfs as if they weir never hear punctual. Customer service was 5 stars explained how system works anced any questions we had and explained lights and different colours meant, where battery can plug into and how it helps cool with heat sink and fan.
Local company, competitive price, professional service. Would not hesitate recommending them.
From the quoting process, acceptance, planning, communication and installation, Solarpro were very good and delivered on their promises.

As someone new to solar power, Alex was really helpful and helped compare system configurations, especially as we increased our solar transition to solar batteries and EV charging. Martin and the installation team were fantastic. Everything was explained including the app to monitor power generation. Overall, a great company to use for your solar installation. We opted for optimised solar panels and batteries within the next 12 to 18 months. Highly recommend Solar Pro.

Quote process very good and salesperson actually got on to our roof area via nternal access to see what was best options for panels. other businesses quoting said did not need to access this areainstallation done in 1 day.Customer service excellent.

I had 11kw of solar panels with a 10k solaredge inverter installed.They were price competitive and also the most experienced company from the quotes I received.. They were well organized from their sales staff, to support staff and always contactable on the phone and always had all the details at the ready. Really great customer service. Their installers also did a very good job, they were professional and enjoyed their work which is a great sign.So far very happy and have had no issues.

Whole process was very professional, from the early contact, the quote and sales process which was clearly explained, the follow up, and the installation. The installation team was polite, hardworking, efficient and did a good looking job. All very professional.

(Initial size was approx 11.5kw but there's no dropdown around that or a custom entry.)Sales was fine albeit I was informed I'd likely need a export limiter which none of the other suppliers indicated. In the end it wasn't installed anyway so not sure how much of a sale pitch it was. I picked them because they were pragmatic and local with a long running good looking history.Installation seemed great on the day (or rather 2 days) the staff were polite and courteous and i had minimal disruption.It was after installation that I started to have issue. Over the first couple of weeks I rather felt that the installation wasn't running as well as i should. At peak I'd only be getting 8.5kw, i wasnt expecting 11+ as the inverter is only rated at 10kw. I enquired and was told that my layout wasnt optimal and that 50kwh/day was great. It was in line with the little graph they gave me but like everything that thing was a guide noone was committing to it being accurate and i cound that both way.My lack of comfort led me into investigating what was happening. I have a electrical/electronic engineering somewhat aged background (i havent practiced it since the 90s) but additionally my current role includes me digging into problems until i know what the issue is and determining how to remediate...1. i noticed that one of the strings was running at a capped 16a (the inverter strings are rated at 16a maximum) and on a good day this was occurring constantly from 10.30am to around 4pm. Futher investigation revealed that the string setup was a parallel 16 panel setup (i.e. 8+8) and that each panel could produce upto 14A in good conditons. This was validated by virtue of another string doing exactly this. This meant i was getting a loss of upto 40% due to the parallel installation (16/(14+14). It was also confusing as to why it had been installed this way because there was a spare mppt input on the inverter not being used.2. Another string only ever got upto 8A... considering that I knew that the panels were rated upto 14A. A LOT of digging into Sungow's documentation revealed that at low voltages (64V) the inverter would put the string into derated mode limiting it at 8A.. I did indeed have less than 64V in one case. I had a small east facing string that had been setup with 2 panels. When it was suggested i asked if it would be sufficient and was informed that provided it started up it would be fine... I dont really see how it was 'fine', running again at around 60% efficient (8A/14A).This led to the supplier remediating the parallel setup and me taking an option to add 2 more panels to the dual panel string and from that day forward i did indeed start seeing 10KW on a regular basis.I would have liked to think that this would have been the end of the installation challenges but it wasnt. I had detected on 4 occasions prior that one string would occasionally fail to startup in the morning, even in full sunlight it would be operating at around 0.7A and from what i could determine to date the only remediation I could find was to restart the inverter however I after the remedial work one morning two of the strings weren't starting. I had already reported the issue to sungrow but there had as yes been no fix. I reported the current situation without restarting the inverter and they checked it out remotely. From what I have since been informed, albeit a little vaguely the mppt optimisation process was set to manual i.e. the panels would great at peak of day but less so during startup/buildup and later in the day. Sungrow enabled mppt tracking and two things have since changed. Not only has the startup not since failed but I'm getting way more output during the sunrise and sunset period as the strings are being optimised constantly throughout the day.It's still early days but I'm rather hoping that the situation is now resolved....On reflection I have to ask why has this happened, why did I have to self investigate and why wasn't the system optimised? I think the hint was in the suppliers other offerings which are likely more the norm for them. The typically use panel optimisers in the setups and dont rely on the inverters for optimisation, and likely are unfamiliar with the specific inverter model i had installed. As such they are less familiar with what they installed and how to effectively configure it. Not encouraging when you pick a supplier based on their longevity and perceived experience.

Sales process was great. Peter came on site and answered many questions, and also helped afterwards as I still had more questions and wanted to make additional changes.The installation scheduling went well, was kept informed throughout of next steps, and the installers on the day were professional and did a great job.They also helped organize the grid connection, and do free monitoring of the system to ensure things are working as expected.I plan to continue reaching out to them for additional energy needs over the coming years.

Very professional.  Met on Monday, quoted the same day, ordered that week and installed by the next Friday.  Install team were very professional, courteous. They had to make changes to layout, gave us the options, and implemented them as agreed.  Great experience overall.
Great team that provided a run down of the setup and provided excellent service and installation

Sales and quoting process was very streamlined and they delivered the required pre-install instructions, install day instructions and subsequent process after install in a timely and very clear manner.The Installation itself was very efficient. They had said would be 5 weeks to wait due to many jobs in the queue, but called after 1 week and said they had cancellation and could do ours in a few days time. They did the install on the day advised, from about 7.30am , finished by 4pm-all done, all rubbish cleared.Post install they have organised the grid install on our behalf, clearly said up to us then to deal with energy retailer to get Feed in tariff rate,etc.

I initially found this company via the Internet. I was impressed by their add and also the reviews they received. I contacted one of the companies that had used them to install their solar system and received positive comments. I emailed the company and my first contact was with the owner Ben Anderson, I explained what I wanted and he was extremally helpful. He spoke to me in layman's terms if I could use that phrase and answered all the questions that I had written down after using the information from Solarquotes. The next person I had contact with was the sales manager also a Ben he was extremely helpful and explained the process for applying for quotes from the Govt agencies. I initially had difficulties especially with scanning documents that were required. When I contacted Ben he made an appointment with me to visit the business premises with all the documentation required and the admin team completed all the parts of the application for me during the entire process the admin team kept me up to date and I sent them the relevant emails that were required that I had received this made the process for me stress free. I also sent photos of  our home as requested and in return Ben sent documentation to me with quotes and suggestions. I did enquire about a heat pump to replace our antiquated gas hot water service. Ben was very helpful with information and sent through via email various documents for me to read. I added that to the solar system and was helped with a grant for the heatpump. I was told from the beginning that there was a 6 week wait for installation. We were granted both quotes thanks to the help of Solar Pro's admin team. The solar system was installed today 20th July, 4 very professional installers arrived as scheduled introduced themselves and the system was installed without a problem. It has been a shocking day freezing cold and rain started half an hour before the system was completed. I was given a demo of the system /invertor and was also shown how to use the phone app. The system is currently off and will be turned on once it has been inspected. The heat pump unfortunately although on the premises and wiring completed will be installed at a later date. Perhaps this is the only criticism that I have when Ben came for an inspection prior to installation he did take photos and mention that the site for the heat pump would need to be levelled out but that the guys doing the installation could sort that out. They have sorted it out and will get a small concrete pad poured and will  them install the pump. I will up load some photos to your site when the weather is not quite so wet. The panels look great so too the inverter which was installed at our front door undercover but does not look ugly at all. Would I recommend this company to my friends I certainly would. I know that if I have any issues I can contact them and the issues will be sorted immediately.

From start to finish Solar Pro has been great to deal with. Taking the time to come and assess the property before organising any quotes and answering all questions in layman's terms made it an easy choice to go ahead with our installation.
Excellent customer service and support all through the process. Yet to receive installation but been very satisfied with experience and quality of product to date

The sales person was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. All contact with the office was quick and easy. They supplied all the information needed and installation was done efficiently on what is a tricky roof profile. Customer service was faultless and Solarpro organised the grid connection process.Malaysian Q Cell panels used.
Smooth process. No pressure selling. Responsive and customer service all good
No complaints whatsoever with Solarpro. Great to deal with.  Only fly in the ointment is the Solaredge inverter which appears to be of substandard quality because it's been replaced twice already.

We had Solarpro install our 7.5kW SolarEdge system with LG panels in 2017. I was so impressed with their continuing after sales service that I thought I would write a review about it. Four weeks ago, I received a call from Sam on the Solarpro support desk informing me that one of my solar panels had failed and was not working anymore. I was unaware of this as I hadn't checked my monitoring app for quite some time. Sam had done all the background work liaising with LG and had arranged a replacement panel under warranty. He then arranged for one of their service team to drop over and replace the faulty panel. My system is up and running again as it should be. What impressed me most was the fact that I didn't even realise I had a problem in the first place and secondly it was all done under warranty, so it was all done free of charge. I am happy we went with Solarpro back then even though at the time they were not the cheapest. Very impressed.

SolarPro were good to deal with, but they're getting a bit stretched. The quality of install has been great but I still had to be firm when it came to getting the details right which sucks for the public just wanting quality solar.Installation was split over a week with panels stacked in the backyard after the brackets were on the roof and I had to convince them to come back out and wire up ethernet despite telling two electricians I had dropped an ethernet switch in an enclosure less than a meter from the inverter.
Professional customer service good advice seamless install hassle free install
All good, installers were very helpful and professional. They answered all my questions in the day and meet my requirements

Solar Pro did an excellent job with our solar installation. Sam was courteous and patient when I had to brush him off when he turned up and we had just swabbed positive to covid. He sent through his quotes and patiently waited for me to work through the different quotes. For me, just being patient and being available to answer questions when needed was a winner for me. Solar Pro also sponsors our local footy that we are heavily tied to, so if was a deciding factor for us when the quotes were pretty similar. Installation went very smoothly. The guys were professional and courteous. Aftercare customer service was spot on as well. No complaints at all here. Would definitely recommend. A+
Customer service strong/ installation process smooth and organized grid connection…great installation..
So far so good, weather has been bad and system has only operating for 2 weeks. But im happy i chose solar pro. Credible business.
Excellent communication throughout. Competitive pricing, responsive service and great quality products.

Many thanks for your prompt attention to my recent leaking roof problem. At all levels, from administrative to practical, the team has performed with great professionalism.The response was quick, and early this morning I was pleased to welcome Tom and Alex, who carefully listened to my account of the problem, and then quietly went on the roof and about their business.They were confronted with some housekeeping tasks (leaf removal) but then quietly and analytically established the cause of the problem.Some restoration works were completed without fuss, and a concise summary was articulated to me. Their report was accompanied by a modest but informative array of photographs confirming their analysis. These two young men should be proud of their courtesy, as well as their professional skills.Today, almost 12 years since my first contact with your company, I felt that the enthusiasm for the PV solar industry, and your role in its development, is still there. Congratulations to all, a really professional effort.

I contacted 3 solar companies to discuss solar. SolarPro was the only one of the 3 that was able to really address some concerns I had e.g. voltage rise and was the most truthful of the bunch. I had one installer tell me that microinverters were unreliable (false, of course they didn't sell them) and another tell me that voltage rise was not a problem for anybody ever (also false). SolarPro was able to work me through different options and put at ease my voltage rise concerns by calculating what my export limit would be.Due to lockdown the installation was contactless, but they still did a great job and everything was installed very neatly and on time.
Clever use of awkward roof space to fit the biggest system on an odd shaped roof which some other companies wouldn’t look at.

Solarpro helpful & professional. Not pushy. Well informed. Answered all questions, even stupid ones. Communicated well. Installers also very professional - on time, no fuss.Still waiting on my Electricity provider to contact me re net meter.
Prompt friendly and clear did what he said he was going to do

Excellent salesman, Harrison. Explained very clearly. Installer Justin was careful, efficient, consultative, tidy, supervised his apprentices well and explained clearly when there was a holdup. Project manager Tischa was polite, obliging and efficient. All paperwork and small details were well organised. I am happy to use them again. They installed our initial system 2 years ago,(16 panels with a battery ) and we have just added another 16 panels in 2021.

Sales / quoting process was good. Liberated Energy was far more comprehensive and for this reason I nearly went with them, however upon doing some research into the quality of products offered I preferred SolarPro's offering. The installation was amazing, the team was punctual, polite and respectful, efficient and I cannot commend them more highly. Customer service by the SolarPro team after the installation was seamless, very happy.
Solarpro were very professional - and we love our new system.

Very professional from the initial contact to quoting after site visit. Answered our questions without bias or trying to oversell components we may not need. Installation was efficient and flawless.  All aspects professional / punctual / thorough. Would highly recommend Solarpro without hesitation.

I was so impressed with the information provided, factual and relevant, the sales person was so accomodating and used many personal examples. The installation process was seamless and the work crew respected our property. The information provided before, during and after was so concise and everyone was so available for questions. From quote to installation took 3 weeks and the ongoing check ins and support is flawless. Very happy and impressed.

Solar pro quoting  process was simple and easy to cross checkinstallation was on time, i'm a building professional with a number of years experience dealing with tradies, Solar pros installers were professional and polite, they got the job done in one day, which was impressive.The grid connection has been handled by solarpro. I'm pretty excited to have bitten the bullet and gone with solar, thanks for the  referencea nd advice on the different levels of equipment quality and performance, this allowed me to drill down onto the sort of choices i was comfortable with

The process with SolarPro couldn't have been easier. From quotation thru to installation the SolarPro team guided us and kept us up to date. The installation team were on site early and worked quietly and efficiently.

Quoting process was very easy, they came out to my house. I had 3-4 other quotes. SolarPro was very detailed with their information and the quote was extensive with efficiency calcs, payback period, all components specified with exact model numbers, some other companies weren't as detailed. Installation for quite a big system (20 panels) all happened on one day. Not the cheapest quote I got but I was most comfortable with them and their expertise. Also local to me and I had a glowing recommendation from a good friend. Overall happy with it.
Very professional company. The installation was seamless and quick. Polite staff. Not the cheapest but not expensive either. Great experience

SolarPro are excellent. David and his team always provide prompt, friendly service. The company is obviously driven from the top down by an excellent business ethic. In a world absurdly obsessed with $$, SolarPro focus on the client. This rare, invaluable quality is not easy to find, especially in a market that attracts inexperienced cowboys. Put simply - the SolarPro team know exactly what they are doing and they do it right every time. After a decade as a very satisfied client, I recommend SolarPro  unconditionally.

The quote was not the cheapest or best.I chose mainly because they were local and well established.The best quote actually came from Queensland. I chose to support local over the Qld as I refuse to spend any money in that State after their treatment of NSW residents and lack of compassion during the COVID crisis.

Installation was seamless process, from install of system to getting smart meter done etc. Very good process - bit of a delay but that wasn't the fault of solar pro.Overall though highly recommended - smooth process. To early to tell on value for money as only been in a short time. However everything working excellent so far!

Quoting/Sales was helpful and without any pressure. Happy to change the quoted system elements to suit our specifications.Good 'whole of system' warranty.The installion was quick, on time, professional and clean.Good setup and activation of monitoring.

Gavin was very helpful and was old fashioned in the way we expect a salesman to be and he followed up with calls a few days later. The teamthat installed the system were very clean and tidy workers and all was explained easily understood.

SolarPro were very knowledgeable and happy to share their advice for our setup. The sales team were attentive and promptly answered all questions. The installation team were cheerful and happy to show us around as they installed. They left no mess and all in all I’d be happy to recommend them based on the great service we received.

Solarpro were professional from the moment Peter Henry the sales executive came to see us.  The installation went smoothly and the team throughout the process were fantastic.  From Kyle, the electrician, Tom and Brad the installers and the office team Julie, Phoebe, Narelle and Lisbet.  We are absolutely thrilled with the system and thank you also to Finn and Solarquotes who started us on this path.
Everything went smoothly from start to end and we got the best system available.
Solar Pro were awesome. Top quality team with skilled electricians and deep knowledge. Highly recommend.
Good advice, responsive, quality installation, a good company to work with.

The install was poorly performed by SolarPro with several north East facing panels hidden up against a western wall.Confusion created by a breakdown in the SolarPro design team and the SolarPro install team resulting in the prime solar roof real estate taken by the pool heating.SolarPro owner argued it was best to install all panels facing west to capture energy during the time it is most expensive.

A simple affair thanks to Solarquotes for helping with the pre installation stage, then decided on Solarpro as the quote was the most comprehensive without being confusing. Installation went ahead smoothly, in at 7:30am and finished at 1:30pm using a planned for conduit. Patrick was great. All the Solarpro team were very good. Just waiting for AGL to do the last bit. Thanks all, very happy.

Overall the experience has been very good. The quote was competitive and the design was exactly what I had discussed. Three options of varying prices were offered and each included a detailed breakdown. The products offered were high quality and the warranty periods are quite long. When the quote was provided it included documents for all of the components plus details about the installation and no-contact policy during Covid. The team kept me in the loop on what I had to do to prepare plus timelines. They even helped to get someone in to replace my main switchboard as this would have been a problem in terms of finishing the installation.On the day of installation the team arrived and worked solidly from early morning to dusk to get the work completed. The installation looks very neat. It matches the roof and there are no stray cables visible. They even shifted a vent on the roof to make sure the installation was in a better position to avoid shading. The installation team were very polite and professional. The next day I had access to the online monitoring tool and everything was operational. They organised all of the grid connection details after the installation. Overall a great experience.

The sales/quoting process was professional and helpfulThe installation was very smooth.The installers were on time and left the site very clean.They have organised a grid connection which will happen in a couple of weeks

I approached the three suggested installers.One didn't come out, provided a quote which seemed reasonable, no opportunity to discuss my needs, didn't reply to my email asking further questions.Another did come out to quote and discuss. The salesperson decided to quote for a very large system which would have meant that we were selling a large proportion of what we would be producing back into the grid. He didn't consider that we had 3-phase nor the distance we were from the service lines.-SolaPro - salesperson was knowledgeable, took his time to properly understand our situation and suggest what would be best for us. He gave us a range to chose from for panels, inverter, battery and went through the pros and cons of each. We ended up adding a battery which was not our initial position but now believe it will provide a better system. Our decision was based on quality products and installer, not on price.

See above. Several visits to site by two different people were necessary to resolve both the possible location for battery and inverter, and to get power between the roof, three stories above, into the garage. A third party was engaged to drill holes through two balconies into the garage. Solution works well. Restoration satisfactory. Electrician in charge did very good job.We were lucky enough to (unexpectedly) buy a new house, but no provision had been made by the developer for the potential installation of solar power.Also I'd like to say how unhappy i am with government energy, GHG, and climate change policies.

Quote process pretty straightforward.Installation a bit messy. We scheduled date and then I advised this coincided with a neighbourhood power shut down for essential maintenance. I then emailed to advise this and said we should re-schedule. The admin person said the installers would not need power so would go ahead. Thought this was odd but went along with it. Of course when they show up they of course need power so they were able to do as much non-electrical as they could and then had to re-schedul to complete the install. When they came back, unfortunately for them the day was too windy, so had to return the next day which they completed it in. They did apologise for the inconvenience.They also left a few parts lying on the roof afterward but this was minor. The system also never seems to achieve the quoted power generation. Apart from this reasonably happy with the system and would recommend them.

The sales and quoting process was excellent, Sam inspected the site in person before quoting and provided detailed advice, eg the usual location for the inverter (next to the meter box) might not work so well for us, and suggested an alternative. Communication was prompt and efficient before, during and after installation. Their quote wasn't the cheapest for the system we chose, but we felt their attention to detail was worth the additional cost. Customer service was great, with detailed information about preparation for the installation. They organised the grid connection, all we had to do was confirm the timing of the installation of the smart meter with the energy supplier. The installation was delayed by a day but we were notified in advance which was fine. The installers arrived on time and worked hard to complete the work within a day. They were polite and helpful and for the most part took considerable trouble to avoid unsightly external electrical conduit etc. They removed all packaging etc from the site, though there were a considerable number of tile chips plus some hardware debris left in the gutters (photo) which now have to be removed by hand as they won't wash out. Two of the sets of panels are connected by an external conduit which runs above a roof valley (photo) - not a great look and I'm not sure how well this will hold up given the exposed location but time will tell I guess. The system has been on the grid for a week now and overall is performing very well, the online monitoring portal is excellent.

The quotation was straightforward, with detailed information about the layout and components. Before installation, we agreed on a slight variation to the original layout as I was concerned about some shadowing.The installation team arrived on time, were friendly and courteous, and completed the job as expected the same day. A good explanation was given about the operation of the switchgear and metering. As a new meter was required to be installed by the retailer, the system was left switched off. The following day, the retailer, AGL, were sent an email to advise that the installation was ready for the new meter.Sadly, AGL failed to act on the email until two and a half weeks later, and then advised it would be another two to three weeks before the new meter would be installed and the system switched on to production.

SolarPro provided a thorough consultation and quotation, and listened and responded to our needs. They explained clearly where explanation was required. Emails were professional and timely. The company accommodated my last minute requests without a problem. The installation team was efficient and did a great job. We are mesmerised by the apps showing the ‘free’ power flowing! Looking forward to finding the right energy retailer.
I was really impressed with SolarPro, they were the only company that actually  came and visited the site.

The Sales and Quoting process was good, SolarPro came through and did a full site inspection and then provided me with a detailed walkthrough of the process required, explaining different types of available products and the pros and cons of each.  Staff was friendly throughout and well documented.Installation process was a breeze as well, a team of 5-6 guys working throughout the day from start to finish and had the system almost (more on that later) fully operating before 3pm.The only issue (and not to the installer's fault) was connecting the inverter to the monitoring platform.  However the aftersales support team have been extremely helpful and following up on the outstanding issue thoroughly.Highly recommended installer.

We got 3 quotes via SolarQuotes. Two were provided with no site inspection while one (Solarpro) visited the site. The quote from Solarpro provided more details than the other two and the sales representative (Richard Lock) spent gave us a lot of time during the visit and in subsequent e-mails to explain the options.The installation took place on 22/11/2019. The team was lead by Kyle Vinoly and their approach and quality of work was excellent. They did break some roof tiles but this was identified as a risk in their quote and, as advised by them, I had spares available. I was worried about undetected cracks in tiles being left behind but we've had some rain and no problems so far.There was an issue raised just prior to the installation about the inverter having to be moved from the originally quoted position due to a voltage rise problem. This was the only part of the process that wasn't perfect because I had problems getting more details from the office about what options there were. It was resolved on the day with the installer who clearly explained the issue and we found a suitable alternate location.The system was left off after the installation because Energy Australia needed to replace the meter. Solarpro did submit the request for this but I had to do it again as Energy Australia couldn't find it and I had to change my energy plan anyway to make use of the solar. The meter got changed on 11/12/2019 and I was able to turn on the system.It's been great so far. In combination with a new, variable speed pool pump and adjusting when we run appliances such as the washing machine and dishwasher, we've already seen a big reduction in energy use from the grid. My only criticism of the Solaredge inverter is that it doesn't have a front LCD panel. Not sure how I change the Wi-Fi password if the need arises.To summarise, Solarpro's quote was the highest of the three I received. However, they actually spent the time to look at the site, discuss the pros and cons of the various options, and come up with a configuration that performs well without over-promising on what it could do. This gave me the confidence to spend the money knowing that I would get what they promised with a "quality" installation. They managed to do this so I'm happy.
Job was completed in budget and on time. Salesperson easy to talk with and explained in clear terms.Site was clean and tidy when work done.

Solarpro were a very professional and friendly company to deal with. From quote to installation it was a very smooth process and they answered all my questions honestly and completely. Highly recommended!

Very prompt and friendly sales person. Clear and well explained proposal. Very quick installation date and they dealt with all the Comms with our electricity provider. Installation was excellent and thought out how to make it as neat as possible

Richard Lock our sales person obviously knew his subject and gave us lots of time, answering every question with facts.Installation was very efficient,carried out in 12 hours. We had 24 panels installed in 2 different sites.Grid connection was OK but getting the Solaredge app connected was somewhat frustrating as it kept dropping out. This now sorted and whole system working well.

Thank you for putting me in touch with Solar Pro. All staff have been extremely professional, knowledgeable and reliable: from our first meeting with their System Designer to the Electrician and 4 Installers who installed the system. All staff took the time to answer my questions. They arrived punctually and worked hard throughout the day. I love having the App which shows me in real time how much the panels are generating. Itâ€™s great to be able to see how much we are using from and feeding back to the grid. I would highly recommend this company.

Very happy with our quote and installation from Solarpro. Within their quote were different options for inverters and panels and batteries. The system comprises LG NeON2 panels connected to a SolarEdge SE5000H 5.0kW inverter.Performance over the first month is as expected.A cautionary note: Rather than storing the data for download to one's home computer system, SolarEdge Inverters send data back to a cloud database via the Internet and one logs in to their website to retrieve the consolidated data.  The advantages of improved support and ease of use need to be weighed against security and privacy concerns.  It is unlikely that the data is held within Australia. SolarEdge's terms and conditions (acceptance of which is required to access the data) are of concern as they allow passing of personal data to third parties which is at odds with their privacy policy, and it is not clear which holds sway; one is required to opt out of the receipt of promotional material; the indemnity clause is not reciprocal; and the terms can be amended at SolarEdge's sole discretion.  If push comes to shove the choice of law is that of the State of Israel.  Unless and until the Terms and Conditions are amended use of their inverters and the associated service is not recommended.

I found the Solar Quotes website an excellent resource to use when planning my solar setup. I asked a couple of questions of the team and had prompt excellent responses.I went to three solar firms for quotes and found a wide variety of prices. CaptainGreen Solar and Solar Pro were the best two organisations i found and i decided to go with SolarPro based on the following reasons:1. The sales person visited my house and reviewed my existing roof and setup, they did not rely purely on google maps or an app2. They provided me with the quote for the system i wanted. CaptainGreen would change the panels slightly or the setup slightly to achieve a better price. Only when i reviewed the quote did i realise that their quote was not an apples to apples quote. This wasted a lot of time in the sales cycle.3. SolarPro were local to me in the Northern Beaches (Sydney) location. This had a very small impact on my decision.This is the setup i opted for which has been running for about a month now with no problems:* 16 LG 330w Panels* Solar Edge 5KW Inverter (the newer slimline model)* 16x SolarEdge OptimisersBased on my experience i would have the following recommendations to anyone looking at solar:1. The Optimisers are only worth it if you have a partially shaded roof, if not i wouldn't bother with the expense2. The SolarEdge monitoring is a nice to have but it's not essential.3. The LG panels are expensive but have a good warranty and a good reputation. I would consider a cheaper tier one panel with more panels if i had more roof. I would suggest opting for the cheapest tier one panels you can find that are not manufactured in China that have the warranty you are looking for. When looking at the warranty ask a specific question about the replacement. If you have a faulty panel is the warranty just a replacement service or will the manufacturer take down the faulty panel and replace it with a new one. There is a lot of value in this if so.4. Check to ensure you have a metered connection in with the quote before signing up. This is often mandatory and can cost $600.00. Some utility companies will provide a metered connection for free (often includes a change from a analog meter to a digital meter) as long as you sign up for electricity from them. However, as they are offering this for free there can often be quite a wait between signing up and the meter being installed (it is free!).5. Margins for solar fitters. From my experience i would say there is a 5-10% negotiating position between the first quote you receive from most solar providers and what you can negotiate them down to accept.Solar for me is a no brainer. I have a swimming pool and the pool pump now runs only between 11am and 3pm when the solar is running well!
